topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I can't believe this is happening. My neighbor just decided to put up a fence right on the property line, without even a heads-up. Now, I find out he’s planning to start construction this weekend, as if it’s his right to alter our shared views and the open space I’ve grown used to enjoying. I’ve got every intention of heading over there to let him know that installing a fence isn’t a solo decision, especially not one that impacts the aesthetics and openness I paid for when I bought this house. I’ve got some words for him, and I’m sure he’ll understand the importance of a little communication next time.
